subject: School Committee and Election Charter Revisions
overview: The committee debated and approved draft charter language for Articles 4 and 7, focusing on the composition of the school committee and election procedures. They also rejected a proposed preamble amendment concerning public participation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the April 18th meeting.

items.title: Preamble Revision for Public Participation
items.summary: Rejected a proposed addition to the preamble regarding public participation in city meetings.

items.title: School Committee Composition (Article 4)
items.summary: Discussed a proposal for a school committee composed of four combined ward seats and members debated the legal requirements for defining these boundaries.

items.title: Mayor's Role on School Committee
items.summary: Approved retaining the mayor as the chairperson of the school committee after a motion to remove the chair designation failed.

items.title: School Committee Terms and Duties
items.summary: Approved Article 4 as revised, maintaining two-year terms and streamlining the language regarding eligibility and the secretary's duties.

items.title: Elections (Article 7)
items.summary: Approved Article 7 as revised, which includes a provision to randomize ballot positions rather than prioritizing incumbents.

items.title: Future Meeting Planning
items.summary: Discussed the timeline for upcoming article reviews and the formation of a subcommittee to draft the final report over the summer.
